purpose: Source-only verification of helper queries assembled from optional SQL filter lists and positional parameter lists.

analysis.supported_shape: Local literal clause and parameter lists receive simple append operations guarded by if/else branches; an f-string interpolates the joined clauses and passes the parameter list to execute/query.
analysis.behavior: Enumerate every guard combination, resolve each SQL variant, and compare positional placeholder count with the corresponding parameter-list length.
analysis.scope_limit: The generic optional-filter solver does not certify tenant/location-scope correlation. Nested, computed, aliased, reassigned, or otherwise unrecognized mutations remain unresolved.

acceptance_limit: Static AST and synthetic source tests verify recognized source shapes and bind arity. They do not prove runtime SQL execution, tenant isolation, populated report output parity, or provider behavior.
